events.what: Preprint on Preprints.org claiming to prove the Feit–Thompson divisibility statement when p and q are twin primes (p = q+2)
events.credibility_reason: Author unidentified in the record; the paper's title and declared dual purpose are methodological ('research based on contradictory sources'); no journal version, citation or expert uptake found in 2.5 years; and the researcher never opened the text, so the claimed content rests only on search-engine snippets.

judgement.doubts: F16: the only event was never opened (preprints.org and ResearchGate returned 403); its scope, correctness and AI disclosure (no acknowledgements read) are inferred from indexed abstract snippets. The record also renders the expression as p^(q-1)/(p-1), apparently a transcription slip for (p^q-1)/(p-1). Codes are left as written; if the preprint were read, it may deserve not_credible (unknown author, methodological framing, no uptake) and the status would fall to open. The twin-prime restriction, if genuine, is a legitimate case of the bullet.

corrections.why: F16/F5: kept, but the sole supporting preprint was never opened and shows doubt signals (unidentified author, methodological 'contradictory sources' framing, no citation or review in 2.5 years); status rests on snippets only.
